name: prisma-sql-logger
description: Log Prisma queries with parameters inlined as runnable SQL
author: sillysillyman

scripts.test:integration: npm run test:integration:mysql && npm run test:integration:postgresql
scripts.test:integration:mysql: tsx scripts/generate-schema.ts mysql && prisma generate --schema prisma && vitest run --config vitest.integration.config.ts tests/integration/mysql.test.ts tests/integration/mysql/
scripts.test:integration:postgresql: tsx scripts/generate-schema.ts postgresql && prisma generate --schema prisma && vitest run --config vitest.integration.config.ts tests/integration/postgresql.test.ts tests/integration/postgresql/
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck:mysql && npm run typecheck:postgresql
scripts.typecheck:mysql: tsx scripts/generate-schema.ts mysql && prisma generate --schema prisma && tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.mysql.json
scripts.typecheck:postgresql: tsx scripts/generate-schema.ts postgresql && prisma generate --schema prisma && tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.postgresql.json
scripts.prepublishOnly: npm run lint && npm run format:check && npm run typecheck && npm run test && npm run build
